task_context: Corporate tax/FP&A task: compute regular MACRS depreciation for a small fixed-asset register. The core domain-knowledge gap being tested is whether the agent knows -- without being told -- that IRS rules require the mid-quarter convention instead of the default half-year convention whenever more than 40% of a year's aggregate depreciable basis is placed in service in the fourth quarter, and that each asset then uses its own placed-in-service quarter's percentage table for every year of its recovery period, not only its first year. This rule and its percentage tables are not stated anywhere in the task materials -- the agent must know or correctly derive them, the way a real corporate tax preparer would.
